board: North Dakota State Board of Accountancy

cycle.note: North Dakota reporting years run July 1 – June 30, with CPE reported at renewal by June 30. Each year needs 20 hours; the rolling three years need 120, including 6 of ethics.

requirements.label: Three-year total
requirements.note: 120 hours in the three reporting years ending June 30 (N.D. Admin. Code 3-03-01-01).

requirements.label: Minimum each year
requirements.note: At least 20 hours every reporting year (July 1 – June 30).

requirements.label: Ethics
requirements.note: 6 hours of ethics in the rolling three reporting years. No North Dakota-specific course is required.

newLicensee.note: No CPE is due for the reporting year you were certified in. After that, 20 hours a year; the 120 and the 6 ethics hours apply once three full reporting years have passed.

licenseDateHint: North Dakota licenses renew every year by June 30, with your CPE report.
issueDateHint: If you were certified this reporting year (since July 1), no CPE is due for it.
limitsNotTracked: Credit is earned in fifths of an hour (10 minutes = 0.2).
Teaching: up to twice the program credit, not for repeat presentations.
Only a certificate of attendance or completion counts as proof.
recordRetention: Keep CPE records for 5 calendar years after the year you took the course. CPE is reported through the Board's Certemy portal.
toVerify: A 2020 Board notice set a lower requirement (60 over three years, 16 a year) for CPAs who don't practice; it isn't in the 2024 rules and isn't modelled.
New licensees: the three-year totals start with the first full reporting year after certification.
